call.text: The authors’ architecture uses a two‑stage hierarchical design in which a routing module dynamically draws chunk boundaries and a downsampler retains vectors based on those indicators, forming the first level of hierarchy, and a second level is created by applying the same dynamic chunking process to the already compressed representation, yielding a nested hierarchy of chunks [HNET:1:c012]. The authors report that H‑Net (2‑stage) is significantly better than H‑Net (1‑stage), indicating that adding a second dynamic‑chunking stage improves performance [HNET:3.1:c049].
